title: Sophie Casterwill/Quotes
summary:
"Don't worry about it, I always keep my word. On the condition, of course, that you take that silly hat off your head."
- Sophie Casterwill, to Lok Lambert (A Seeker Is Born)

"When I said I could take care of myself, I meant it!"
- Sophie Casterwill, fighting two Suits (A Seeker Is Born)

"My name is Sophie Casterwill… and I am not alone."
- Sophie Casterwill, to Suits (A Seeker Is Born)

"Attaboy, killer. We're all set - if a deadly Titan disguises itself as Dante's hair."
-Sophie Casterwill, to Lok Lambert (The Legacy of Thor ) - after Lok misfires a Boltflare at Dante

"Let me teach you something about fire."
- Sophie Casterwill, to Incubane ("An Ally from the Organization")
